newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mancera says Mexico interest rates can fall-report.
newsitem.headline: Mancera says Mexico interest rates can fall-report.

text.p: Banco de Mexico governor Miguel Mancera said that conditions exist that will allow interest rates to continue to fall in Mexico, Notimex news agency reported late Saturday.
Mancera told the agency that the central bank will stick to its policy of leaving money markets in a neutral position.
"No more (liquidity than demanded) because this would be inflationary, and not less since this would be recessionary," Mancera was quoted by agency as saying.
He said recent changes in the make-up of Congress since July 6 mid-term elections stripped the long-ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) of its majority will not affect monetary policy.
The central bank governor was in the city of Puebla for the opening of an art exhibition when he spoke to the news agency.
